freeze_commit_status: commit this selection, evidence manifest and protocol before any Blind v4 model call

run_settings.retry_policy: only existing transport and schema-contract retries in frozen semantic_runner; no manual answer-based retry
run_settings.missing_policy: retain errors and incomplete rows; score missing predictions explicitly, never drop their cases

policy.purpose: entry-and-report-isolated evaluation after post-v3 hardening and Prompt 1.5.0, with AI-assisted evidence-reviewed labels
policy.repository_isolation_reason: VulnGym v0.1.4 has no untouched upstream repository after prior development rounds
policy.failure_policy: retain the first attempted Blind v4 run including failures; any result-driven change requires a new evaluation id
policy.reference_isolation: Reference labels and review notes must never be passed to the model; only candidate records and public source/advisory/patch evidence are inputs.
policy.field_policy: Judge the whole field including material descriptive claims. Accept explanatory code comments, defensible alternate sinks and omitted implicit edges. Do not equate missing detail with contradiction. Use uncertain for ambiguous scope wording.
policy.reference_scope: eight unseen entries and reports across eight repositories, reviewed against fixed source, advisory, patch and taxonomy before prediction

cases.focus: MLflow hard-coded Basic Auth default credentials

review.reviewer: AI-assisted fixed-source and official-advisory review; not independent expert Gold

notes.entry_point: The INI line is genuine, but the field explicitly says it is read unconditionally at first startup. config.py:16-25 first honors MLFLOW_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH; create_admin_user:685 also guards existing users. The default-deployment vulnerability remains real.
notes.critical_operation: The admin early return at 493-494 is real. However, its causal explanation asserts authenticate_request writes the admin identity into request context. It simply calls the configured function at 444-447; sender_is_admin independently authenticates again and fetches the stored role at 317-320. The full field's claimed handoff is false.
notes.trace: Nodes 7 and 8 repeat the nonexistent request-context handoff. Node 6 also names bcrypt although the source imports Werkzeug check_password_hash/generate_password_hash. The context mechanism, not a missing intermediate node, is the decisive error.
notes.commit: The candidate contains the public default credential and affected Basic Auth flow. Linked advisory patch 5bf2ec2b changes artifact traversal in file_store.py, not this flow; it is explicitly not accepted as the credential fix.

cases.focus: Open WebUI cross-user file overwrite authorization failure

review.reviewer: AI-assisted fixed-source and official-advisory review; not independent expert Gold

notes.entry_point: GET knowledge files at 589 is a defensible upstream reconnaissance entry, but 'any authenticated user may call' is ambiguous about shared-read permission. The source at 608-622 requires admin, owner or a read grant. Do not force this wording to mean either arbitrary-KB access or a correctly scoped shared-KB request.
notes.critical_operation: retrieval.py:2805 is the unauthorized DB write. Its description additionally assigns vector-store persistence to that call; the source performs the vector write earlier at 2794-2801, then updates the relational file record. Full-field side-effect attribution is incorrect.
notes.trace: Node 1 explicitly says there is only authentication and any user can query any KB, contradicted by knowledge.py:608-622. This is stronger than the ambiguous entry wording and contradicts the advisory's shared-read-access prerequisite.
notes.commit: The fixed candidate contains the unowned batch write and the read-access check; the advisory's affected release range is consistent. No authoritative atomic fix was selected.
